statements.statement: The patient presents with recurrent palpitations and intermittent lightheadedness

The patient has a personal history of transient ischemic attacks

The diagnosis code for transient cerebral ischemia is G45.9

The claim was denied with reason code PR-204
The denial reason is that this specific service is not covered under the beneficiary's current benefit plan
